## 1. Executive Summary

In response to the **Gate Verification Pack** requirements, every previous assertion was treated as unverified until converted into verifiable evidence on disk. All files and reports have been produced under `docs/qa/reports/`, and duplicate storage mirrors were cataloged with SHA-256 manifests and deleted.

### Status Totals (Generated by [`scripts/qa_count.sh`](file:///data/user/0/com.agy/files/.gemini/antigravity-app/scratch/TransLiveApp/scripts/qa_count.sh))
- **Total Inventory Items:** 28
- **PASS:** 0
- **NOT VERIFIED:** 27
- **MANUAL:** 1
- **FAIL:** 0
- **BLOCKED:** 0

Per **Rule Zero**, a status is PASS only when a verifiable artifact exists (JUnit report, CI log, command output, or screenshot). Because the current Android container lacks a local Java runtime (`java: command not found`), Android SDK, adb, and the Firebase CLI, unit tests and emulator instrumentation tests cannot execute locally and are honestly classified as **NOT VERIFIED**.

| **OD-04** | Gemini Model | `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` availability vs fallback | Strict single model binding | Fallback cascade enabled | Option A (Strict single model; cascade disabled) | **OPEN** |
